name: aztec-isle
description: A calm, tactile god game: Aztec tribes settling a lush tropical island.

scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.islander:prepare: for g in male female; do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python scripts/blender/prepare_islander.py -- art/islander_${g}_source.glb public/models/islander_${g}.glb 2000 512 art/islander_${g}_extra.glb; done
